instruction: I'd like to have a larger, more finger-friendly interface for Thunderbird. Can you change the UI to use touch density mode?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Thunderbird UI density to touch mode for larger, more accessible interface. The evaluator checks if mail.uidensity preference is set to 2 (touch). Standard Thunderbird preference: 0=default, 1=compact, 2=touch. Similar complexity to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks mail.uidensity preference for touch density mode
Expected value (mail.uidensity=2) is semantically correct for touch mode
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird to ensure prefs.js is written to disk before verification
Getter correctly retrieves prefs.js from the Thunderbird profile directory
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js and validates preference values
Data flow is complete and correct: user action -> pref change -> app close -> file write -> file read -> value check
Metric handles edge cases (returns 0.0 if file is None)
Complete coverage: instruction requires touch mode, evaluator verifies touch mode preference

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
